title: Pleating Lurex Tulle Shimmer Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this enchanting evening dress! Featuring delicate pleating, ethereal tulle, and romantic ruffle sleeves, it exudes timeless elegance. The flattering silhouette and flowing design make it perfect for weddings, galas, or any glamorous occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Ruffle sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
